Name: Easy Mall
Author: gggl634624654567
Description:
All items collected in the collection page and all seeds are sold in the mall, can purchased them remotely.

Usage:
press Q key to open the main menu of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21181]Easy Valley[/url] mod, then select "Easy Mall" menu item.
